notes: Single home for the ops data system's expectations. One entry per feed the ETL is meant to land in Neon Postgres (etl_feed_rows). status=expected feeds are verified daily by verify.yml (MakiManc/ops) and their fetch failures turn the ETL run red (etl_receipt.py in MakiManc/maki-hospitality-etl). status=known_broken feeds never alert - flip the field to expected the day the underlying fetch is fixed. min_rows floors are deliberately generous (~40% of the 14-day minimum observed at calibration); the verifier's row-count band check self-calibrates against a trailing median on top of this. A feed missing from this manifest raises a warning (check 5) and its fetch failure turns the run red - new feeds must be added here or fly blind. A feed the ETL no longer pulls must be REMOVED from here, or check 1 reports it as never having landed forever: the four Mapal Easilys feeds (Supplier Orders, Smart Delivery, Smart Yield, Invoices To Receive) went on 27/08/2026 when Ross confirmed the business does not use Easilys.

feeds.name: Factory Broth Readings
feeds.note: The factory refractometer form's responses, pulled whole every day (factory_broth.py in the ETL repo), so the row count is the form's entire history and only ever grows - roughly +3 a day. min_rows is a floor set BEFORE the feed's first landing, not a calibration: it is there to catch a wiped or wrong tab, and should be re-floored against a fortnight of real pulls. The verifier's 0.5x-3x band self-calibrates on the trailing median regardless.

feeds.name: GC Locations Changelog
feeds.note: NOT the same feed as 'GC Location Changelog' (singular), which is the per-location fan-out and is known_broken. This one is the date-ranged 'locations-changelog' endpoint, and it was missing from this manifest entirely until 27/08/2026 - so every run where it hit a 429 was classed 'fetch failed and feed is NOT in the manifest', the hardest red the receipt has, for a feed nobody had ever declared. It fetches most days and has returned 0 rows on every one of them, so min_rows is 0 deliberately: a floor on a feed with no rows to floor would be noise. The entry exists so its fetch failures are classified rather than treated as an undeclared feed. weekly from 28/08/2026 - nothing reads this feed, and a full GetCompliant pull (77 calls) exhausts the API's quota mid-run. See GetCompliantClient.DAILY_TABS.
